cases.sentence: Так говорит держащий в правой руке семь ___
cases.translation: He who holds seven stars in his right hand
cases.explain: After numbers 5-20, nouns take the genitive case
The possessive adjective 'твою' requires accusative case for feminine nouns

cases.sentence: Побеждающему я дам право есть плоды с ___ жизни
cases.translation: the fruits from the tree of life
cases.explain: After the preposition 'с' (from), nouns take the genitive case
After the preposition 'в' (in), nouns take the prepositional case

cases.sentence: Ты проверил тех, кто выдает себя за ___
cases.translation: You tested those who claim to be apostles
cases.explain: The preposition 'за' requires accusative case; for animate plural nouns, accusative equals genitive

cases.sentence: Я знаю, что ты не можешь мириться со злыми ___
cases.translation: I know you cannot tolerate evil people
cases.explain: The verb 'мириться' followed by 'с' requires instrumental case

cases.translation: I will give you the crown of life
cases.explain: After the transitive verb 'дам' (give), the direct object takes accusative case

cases.translation: how to provoke the people to sin
cases.explain: After the transitive verb 'спровоцировать' (provoke), animate nouns take accusative case

reading.ru: Церкви в Эфесе Ангелу церкви в Эфесе напиши.
reading.question: To which church is this message addressed?
reading.explain: The opening explicitly states 'Ангелу церкви в Эфесе напиши' (Write to the angel of the church in Ephesus)

reading.ru: Я знаю, что ты стоик, что ради моего имени перенес трудности и не изнемог.
reading.question: What does the speaker know about the church in Ephesus?
options: They have persevered and endured hardship for His name
They have become weak and uncertain
reading.correct: They have persevered and endured hardship for His name
reading.explain: The text states 'ты стоик, что ради моего имени перенес трудности и не изнемог' (you are steadfast and have endured hardships for my name)

reading.ru: Но у меня есть нечто против тебя. Ты оставил свою первую любовь.
reading.question: What is the main criticism of the church in Ephesus?
options: They have left their first love
reading.correct: They have left their first love
reading.explain: The text directly states 'Ты оставил свою первую любовь' (You have left your first love)

reading.ru: Однако ты правильно делаешь, что ненавидишь дела Николаитов, которые и я ненавижу.
reading.question: What does the church in Ephesus do correctly?
options: They hate the works of the Nicolaitans
reading.correct: They hate the works of the Nicolaitans
reading.explain: The text says 'ты правильно делаешь, что ненавидишь дела Николаитов' (you do well in hating the works of the Nicolaitans)

reading.ru: Я знаю твои страдания и твою бедность, впрочем, ты богат.
reading.question: What paradox is described about the church in Smyrna?
options: They are poor but rich spiritually
reading.correct: They are poor but rich spiritually
reading.explain: The text presents the paradox: 'твою бедность, впрочем, ты богат' (your poverty, but you are rich)

reading.ru: Если ты не раскаешься, то я приду к тебе и уберу твой светильник с его места.
reading.question: What consequence is threatened if the church does not repent?
options: Jesus will remove their lampstand from its place
Jesus will turn them over to Satan
reading.correct: Jesus will remove their lampstand from its place
reading.explain: The text states 'я приду к тебе и уберу твой светильник с его места' (I will remove your lampstand from its place)
